name: hr-cellular-dialer-suite
description: Production Android Cellular Dialer with Browser Testing Mode for HR Teams

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,web,admin" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=shared run build && npm --workspace=web run build && npm --workspace=admin run build && npm --workspace=server run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=shared run test && npm --workspace=server run test && npm --workspace=web run test
scripts.test:android: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; cd android; .\gradlew.bat testDebugUnitTest"
scripts.build:android: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; cd android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug"
